page.title: Attachment component showcase
page.description: Scenario tabs driven by view.json; copy and catalog codes come from gen JSON.
page.pickRowSingleImage: Single cover / logo → AttachmentManager mode=single variant=image
page.pickRowCatalog: Catalog slots table → CatalogAttachmentManager; codes from view.json fileCatalogs (sample catalog=attachment_demo). Full closed loop: menu Attachment Demo.
page.bizLoopHint: Full business loop (table/save/ref sync/delete): Infra → File Config → Attachment Demo
page.pickRowWrappers: Other single-image cases (e.g. banner) also use AttachmentManager — only swap bizType; do not introduce CoverImagePicker / OaFileUpload
page.pickRowSpecial: Avatar crop / rich-text embed / admin storage upload → keep hand-written components
page.whenMultiList: OA attachments, form file field, any multi-file list.
page.whenCatalog: Business form driven by infra_file_catalog via view.json fileCatalogs.
page.whenBannerImage: Banner etc.: bizType=banner_image, downloadScope=infra; same component as notice cover, different constants.
page.whenSpecial: Special interactions that must not be replaced by AttachmentManager.
page.snippetSingleImage:
import { AttachmentManager, FILE_BIZ_NOTICE_COVER, FILE_DOWNLOAD_SCOPE_NOTICE } from '@/components/attachment'

<AttachmentManager
  v-model="form.coverFileId"
  v-model:preview-url="form.coverPreviewUrl"
  :biz-type="FILE_BIZ_NOTICE_COVER"
  :download-scope="FILE_DOWNLOAD_SCOPE_NOTICE"
  mode="single"
  variant="image"
/>
page.snippetMultiList:
import { AttachmentManager, FILE_BIZ_OA_INSTANCE, FILE_DOWNLOAD_SCOPE_INFRA } from '@/components/attachment'

<AttachmentManager
  v-model="form.fileIds"
  :biz-type="FILE_BIZ_OA_INSTANCE"
  :download-scope="FILE_DOWNLOAD_SCOPE_INFRA"
  mode="multiple"
  variant="list"
  :max-files="5"
/>
page.snippetCatalog:
import { CatalogAttachmentManager } from '@/components/attachment'
import viewConfig from '@/i18n/gen/yourBiz/view.json'

// catalogCode from view.json fileCatalogs[].code
<CatalogAttachmentManager
  v-model="form.attachments"
  :catalog-code="viewConfig.fileCatalogs[0].code"
  :biz-id="form.id"
  @change="({ fileIds }) => (form.fileIds = fileIds)"
/>
page.snippetBannerImage:
import { AttachmentManager, FILE_BIZ_BANNER_IMAGE, FILE_DOWNLOAD_SCOPE_INFRA } from '@/components/attachment'

<AttachmentManager

  :biz-type="FILE_BIZ_BANNER_IMAGE"

/>
